findings.source: All four grounded harness seats and separate independent review
findings.finding: Incorrect fake/live ownership and missing actual fake-server request rejection controls.
findings.repair: SL-4 owns fake-omnigent-server.ts and live-omnigent-smoke.test.ts; existing conformance must cover malformed/oversized/aborted request refusal, handled rejection, response cleanup and subsequent valid service. Preserve GUARD skip enrollment.

findings.finding: Caller mutation can change send/cancel scope after lease acquisition is queued.
findings.repair: Validate and detach mutation inputs before first await/queue; explicitly test mutation during lease/fence waits with consistent lease/fence/key/wire target and body.

findings.finding: CLI provider maps and injected history/events lack capacity coverage.
findings.repair: Shared finite OmnigentTransportLimits consumed by HTTP and CLI options; SL-3 owns admission before transport effects, mapper inputs, concurrent reservations, closed transient cleanup and protected idempotency.

findings.finding: No frozen retained-byte/key limit or runner capture contract.
findings.repair: Freeze aggregate64MiB retained state, bounded UTF-8 accounting and exact ceilings/defaults; runner options carry deadline/abort/capture cap, transport independently rejects oversize before JSON.parse and bounds waiting. No giant key can evade count-only admission.

findings.finding: Per-page bounds do not bound cumulative paginated collection.
findings.repair: All history/session/child collection walks share row/byte/page/deadline budgets including stale-cursor restart; advancing tiny-page probes must refuse finitely before retaining more data.

findings.finding: Unknown create result can evict its key and duplicate a dispatched mutation.
findings.repair: Bounded uncertain-create tombstones return deterministic same-key failure with zero second POST/CLI create; only proven pre-dispatch refusal can release capacity.

findings.finding: Base query/fragment behavior and per-turn timeout precedence unclear.
findings.repair: Reject base query/fragment before effects; per-turn timeout can shorten but never extend transport request deadline, independently of terminal turn execution.

findings.finding: Fresh per-seat review checkout requirement not explicit.
findings.repair: Require qualified fresh immutable per-seat harness snapshots and separate manual/native checkouts with exact source/delta binding.

findings.finding: Qualified validator interprets pnpm --filter package name as missing path.
findings.repair: Use pnpm --dir packages/omnigent-transport typecheck and direct node scripts/smoke-packed-omnigent-transport.mjs; complete verification command validation passes.
